sn22.118:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || || Rūpam etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassathāti || || No hetam bhante || || Sādhu bhikkhave || Rūpam bhikkhave netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti || evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammapaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Vedanaṃ || Saññaṃ || Saṅkhāre || || Viññānam etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti samanupassathāti || || No hetam bhante || || Sādhu bhikkhave || viññāṇam bhikkhave netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || pa || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
